messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need new KV/prefix-cache metrics for the per-route dashboard. Noticed token latency spikes when reuse drops.
drake: +1. Saw a regression on canary: avg token latency up ~12% correlated with prefix reuse rate falling. Attaching profiler output.
perf-bot: Profiling summary (1765432090): model=gptx-13b, route=/chat/compose, avg_token_ms=3.1, kv_lookup_ms=0.45, kv_hit_rate=0.61, kv_evictions_per_min=8
sam: can you paste the profiler snippet? also which kernel selection changes landed this week?
drake: snippet:```
# hotspots
KV::lookup 0.45ms (40%)
AttentionKernel::matmul 0.9ms (50%)
Batching::schedule 0.15ms (10%)
```
ingrid: Proposed metrics to instrument:
- prometheus: `redwood_kv_hits_total`, `redwood_kv_lookups_total`, `redwood_kv_evictions_total`, `redwood_kv_mem_bytes`
- gauges: `redwood_prefix_distinct`, `redwood_prefix_reuse_rate{route,model}`
- histograms: `redwood_kv_lookup_ms_bucket` (token-level latency)
sam: Queries for grafana panels:
- hit rate: `rate(redwood_kv_hits_total[5m]) / rate(redwood_kv_lookups_total[5m])`
- per-route reuse: `avg(redwood_prefix_reuse_rate) by (route)`
- eviction pressure: `sum(rate(redwood_kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool) / sum(redwood_kv_mem_bytes) by (pool)`
maya: Also add `redwood_kv_last_eviction_ts{route}` and `redwood_prefix_owner{route}` so we can trace which routes cause churn.
drake: For batching heuristics we should emit `redwood_batch_size_per_request` and `redwood_batch_wait_ms` per model so we can correlate with kernel selection metrics.
sam: UI layout idea: token-level waterfall per-route: token_enqueue -> kernel_select -> kv_lookup -> compute -> emit. Use percentiles for each stage (p50/p95/p99).
ingrid: Rollout plan: add metrics on staging for one week, build grafana panels, add alert if reuse_rate < 0.5 for >10m or eviction_rate > 5/min for 5m. Thoughts?
maya: +1. Assigning to drake to instrument, sam for dashboard. I'll create a tiny ticket.
drake: On it. Will instrument counters + histogram, send PR today. pinging @ingrid for alert rules.
sam: thanks — will layout dashboard tiles and attach queries. :thumbsup:
